Thank you. I found some questions challenging because they required balancing personal experiences with broader implications. For instance, Q3.5 on sensitive data was tough—while my disability affects my studies, using such data raises privacy concerns.

The most important questions for model design are those about explainability and fairness (Q4.1 and Q5). The group's biggest difference seems to be around Absalon data (Q3.4) and nationality data (Q3.6.nationality). I chose 'large' for Absalon data because it could provide timely insights, but I understand others' privacy concerns.

For fairness, I prioritized equal recall across groups (Q5.2), which aligns with the majority. However, someone might argue that avoiding unnecessary contact is more important, especially if outreach is resource-intensive. This tension could be resolved by offering an opt-out mechanism for students who find the outreach burdensome.
